content:
## The physical side of the notebook

This photo records the mechanical prototype on the bench. It does not establish a completed autonomous task or a precision specification.

The project connects arm design, simulation, inverse kinematics, and joint tracking. The LARA code repository will be linked when it is available; the project page keeps that space open.
